name: Fuzzy rd

subjectOf.text: Because the compliance probability denominator is very close to one, fuzzy regression discontinuity estimates differ only trivially from the sharp design estimates on the entire sample.
subjectOf.abstract: However, because the denominator is very close to 1 in our investigation, empirical results show that the differences between the SRD and the FRD approach are of minor importance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416
scope_conditions: compliance with mandatory disclosure near certain above the threshold

subjectOf.text: Unlike the entire sample, whose discontinuity coefficient is near zero except in March 2012, the strategic subsample shows a discontinuity coefficient that is always above zero across the sample months.
subjectOf.abstract: While the entire sample has a value always very close to zero, except for March 2012, the strategic subsample has a value always above zero.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416
scope_conditions: fuzzy RD on the 87 fund strategic subsample
